sourceDesign.exportCommand: Read-only Pencil MCP Export per frame, scale 1

comparison: Per-card raster crop: 96 × 8 px of blank top padding, centered, inset 6 px. Allows minor cross-renderer quantization (delta above 8 on any RGB channel; at most 1% changed). Exact layout and token checks guard the surfaces outside this crop; full browser captures attach for review.
adaptations: Live scopes and publication facts, full job IDs, long localized strings and 52 px targets replace shorter illustration content.
Scheduler health and missing notices are mutually truthful states. Scheduler and attempt audit evidence are platform-only. Counts and scheduler evidence remain readable tables.
The correction replay confirmation retains its existing keyboard-accessible modal; the frame's inline confirm block sets surface and control hierarchy, not interaction semantics.
Empty queue and retry confirm are separate states, not simultaneously rendered. Load errors keep distinct denied and retryable states.
